title: 70% of accident outpatient cases are animal bites: Health data
byline: Seventy percent of patients treated for accident-related injuries in hospital outpatient departments are people who have been bitten by animals, the Directorate of Non-Communicable Diseases of the Ministry of Health said.

title: Govt. yet to reach final decision on Sinopec refinery
byline: The government is yet to reach any final decision on the proposed investment of US$ 3.7 billion by Chinese state giant Sinopec mainly due to disagreements on terms and conditions of the project despite the lapse of more than one and half years after signing the MoU.

title: Reduce polythene use, protect environment: CEA
byline: The Central Environmental Authority (CEA), marking International Polythene Bag Free Day, has called on the public to minimize the use of polythene and switch to environmentally friendly, reusable alternatives.

title: UNP has always worked to deepen ties with China : Wajira
byline: Chairman of the UNP Wajira Abeywardena said his party had always worked to deepen friendship with China, and under the leadership of Ranil Wickremesinghe, Sri Lanka threw its weight behind the Belt and Road Initiative as one of its earliest partners and advanced the Colombo Port City, the most ambitious investment project in the nation’s history.

title: Venezuela quake survivor pulled out alive after eight days
byline: A man has been rescued alive after being trapped for eight days in the rubble of a building that collapsed after twin earthquakes in Venezuela.

title: IFRS 17 to bring transparency to life insurance sector, push industry toward protection-led growth
byline: Sri Lanka’s life insurance industry is bracing for a fundamental shift in how its performance is measured and reported, as the country prepares to adopt IFRS 17, the new global accounting standard for insurance

title: Sri Lanka named world’s top trending wellness destination for 2026
byline: Sri Lanka has secured the top spot on BookRetreats.com’s list of the world’s top trending wellness destinations for 2026, marking a significant milestone for the island’s hospitality and tourism sector.

title: Sri Lanka tourist arrivals fall 10% in June
byline: Sri Lanka’s tourist arrivals recorded a 9.9 percent year-on-year decline in June 2026, totalling 124,551 visitors compared to the 138,241 arrivals registered during the same month last year.

title: NTC announces new bus fare hike effective July 6
byline: The National Transport Commission (NTC) has announced a revision of bus fares, which will come into effect from Monday (July 6).

title: Sri Lanka calls for Asia-Pacific support for blue carbon and climate action frameworks
byline: Sri Lanka has called for stronger regional cooperation in the Asia-Pacific to advance integrated climate action and blue carbon financing through shared frameworks involving governments, academia, the private sector, and local communities.

title: 12-hour water cut in Dehiwala, Moratuwa, Ratmalana and surrounding areas
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced that water supply will be temporarily suspended for 12 hours on Saturday (4) due to essential maintenance work on the power supply system feeding the Ambatale Water Treatment Plant.

title: Commander Chaminda Walakuluge returns to head Naval Media
byline: Commander of the Sri Lanka Navy has appointed Commander (N) Chaminda Walakuluge as the new Director of Naval Media with effect from July 1, 2026.

title: Fire destroys 10 acres of Haputale forest reserve
byline: A fire that broke out in the Turpentine Forest Reserve near the Haputale Y-junction has spread rapidly, destroying around 10 acres of land, the Disaster Management Centre (DMC) said.

title: Tibetan man dies after setting himself on fire near UN headquarters
byline: Police in New York City said on Thursday a man ​died from severe burns near the United Nations headquarters, and activists and a media outlet of ‌exiled Tibetans identified him as a Tibetan who set himself on fire in an appeal for independence.

title: Strong wind advisory for several areas
byline: The Department of Meteorology has issued an advisory for strong winds over the Central, Northern, North- Central and North-Western Provinces and in the Ratnapura, Hambantota and Trincomalee districts due to the active south-west monsoonal condition.

title: Russia bombards Kyiv in deadliest strike this year, killing at least 30 people
byline: KYIV, (Reuters) - Russia launched hundreds of drones and dozens of missiles at Ukraine’s capital Kyiv in the early hours of Thursday, killing at least 30 people, wounding scores more and damaging around 130 buildings in the deadliest attack on the capital this year.

title: Former Navy Commander Wasantha Karannagoda arrested
byline: The Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) has arrested former Navy Commander Admiral of the Fleet Wasantha Karannagoda in connection with an ongoing investigation into the recruitment of Yoshitha Rajapaksa to the Sri Lanka Navy.

title: Court dismisses Yoshitha’s revision application relating to “Menik Malla” case
byline: The Court of Appeal today dismissed a revision application filed by Yoshitha Rajapaksa in connection with the money laundering case widely known as the “Menik Malla” case.

title: Sri Lanka, Pakistan discuss stronger cooperation in maritime and aviation sectors
byline: Sri Lanka and Pakistan have agreed to further strengthen bilateral cooperation in the maritime and aviation sectors during a high-level meeting held at the Ministry of Ports and Civil Aviation.

title: Court puts off hearing of Rakitha Rajapaksa’s case until 2 pm
byline: The case against Attorney-at-Law Rakitha Nirmala Rajapaksa, Samagi Jana Balawegaya Horana organiser Charith Wasantha Kumara Abeysinghe and former Airport Director of the Civil Aviation Authority Aruna Sri Chathuranga, who were arrested by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) over the alleged solicitation and acceptance of a Rs. 120 million bribe from the wife of an alleged organised crime figure in exchange

title: Sinopec promises accurate fuel dispensing
byline: Sinopec Energy Lanka has said that its fuel dispensing equipment is designed to ensure accuracy and reliability at every fuel station.

title: Wasantha Karannagoda granted bail
byline: Colombo Chief Magistrate Asanga S. Bodaragama today ordered the release on bail of former Commander of the Sri Lanka Navy, Admiral of the Fleet Wasantha Kumara Jayadeva Karannagoda, who is accused of committing acts of corruption in connection with the recruitment of Yoshitha Rajapaksa to the Executive Branch of the Sri Lanka Navy in 2006.

title: Rakitha, Chatith and Aruna further remanded
byline: Colombo Chief Magistrate Asanga S. Bodaragama today ordered that Attorney-at-Law Rakitha Nirmala Rajapaksha, Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) Horana Organiser Charitha Wasantha Kumara Abeysinghe and former Airport Director of the Civil Aviation Authority Varushahennadige Aruna Sri Chathuranga be further remanded till July 17.

title: Colombo Law Society urges President to abandon plan to extend judges’ retirement age
byline: The Colombo Law Society (CLS), a premier professional association serving attorneys-at-law in Sri Lanka has urged President Anura Kumara Dissanayake to refrain from proceeding with any Constitutional amendment seeking to extend the retirement age of judges of the Supreme Court and the Court of Appeal, warning that such a move could undermine public confidence in the independence of the judiciary.

title: Kelani Valley train services to resume from today
byline: The Railways Department has announced that two previously cancelled train services on the Kelani Valley (KV) line will resume operations from today (3).

title: Private bus driver arrested following reckless road race in Kotavila
byline: Police have taken a private bus into custody and arrested its driver following a viral video showing a highly dangerous and competitive incident of reckless driving.

title: Sri Pada off-season entry restricted to two routes; Pass made mandatory
byline: The Wildlife Conservation Department has announced that during the off-season, access to Sri Pada is strictly permitted only through two designated routes, with all visitors required to obtain an official pass.

title: Vedda Chief wants permanent solution to human-elephant conflict
byline: Vedda Chief Wanaspathi Uruwarigelage Vannila Ettho’s house had been ruined by a rogue elephant on Thursday night.

title: Litro cuts domestic LP gas prices by up to Rs. 300
byline: Litro Gas Lanka today announced a reduction in the prices of domestic LP gas cylinders, with the revised rates taking effect from midnight.

title: Pakistan-Sri Lanka Armed Forces Defence Dialogue concludes in Colombo
byline: The 6th Pakistan-Sri Lanka Armed Forces Defence Dialogue concluded today at the Navy Headquarters in the Defence Headquarters Complex in Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte, with both countries reaffirming their commitment to strengthening bilateral defence cooperation.

title: Google hit with £3.5bn fine following 8-year battle
byline: Google has been handed a European Union fine of €4.1 billion (£3.5bn) following an eight-year battle for using its Android mobile operating system to block rivals.

title: Ponnambalam-led TNPA meets Tamil Nadu CM Vijay, submits demands
byline: A delegation of the Tamil National People’s Assembly (TNPA), led by its leader and MP Gajendrakumar Ponnambalam, today met with the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu Joseph Vijay at the Tamil Nadu Government Secretariat in Chennai and held discussions on several issues concerning Sri Lankan Tamils.

title: Bus crashes into ravine, killing at least 40 in Pakistan
byline: At least 40 people were killed and eight others injured after a passenger bus plunged into a deep ravine in Pakistan’s southwestern Balochistan province on Friday, officials said.

title: Rakitha, Charith and Aruna further remanded
byline: Colombo Chief Magistrate Asanga S. Bodaragama today ordered that Attorney-at-Law Rakitha Nirmala Rajapaksha, Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) Horana Organiser Charitha Wasantha Kumara Abeysinghe and former Airport Director of the Civil Aviation Authority Varushahennadige Aruna Sri Chathuranga be further remanded till July 17.

title: Reconstruction of damaged Kandy–Colombo railway line accelerated
byline: A special operation to expedite the reconstruction of the Kandy–Colombo main railway line between Kadugannawa and Rambukkana, which was severely damaged by Cyclone Ditwah, commenced today (July 3).

title: LAUGFS gas slashes domestic LP gas prices
byline: LAUGFS Gas has announced a significant reduction in domestic LP gas prices, effective from midnight today.

title: French heat wave death toll rises to 2025
byline: France has said it recorded an increase of more than 2,000 deaths during the last week of a record-breaking European heatwave in June as forecasters warn of further extreme temperatures on the continent in the next few days.

title: Spa Association complains to IGP over alleged police action
byline: The Sri Lanka Spa Association says it has lodged complaints with the Inspector General of Police (IGP) and the Human Rights Commission of Sri Lanka (HRCSL), alleging harassment of licensed spa establishments by police and calling for an impartial investigation into recent incidents.

title: CIABOC says Wijeyadasa Rajapakshe was in Dubai during alleged bribe transaction
byline: The Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption yesterday informed court that it has been revealed that former Minister Wijeyadasa Rajapakshe was in Dubai at the time the alleged bribe was received.

title: Early gains fade as profit-taking pushes CSE into negative territory
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) extended the trend observed over the past few trading sessions, with early buying interest failing to sustain momentum as profit-taking emerged later in the day. After opening on a positive note, both benchmark indices gradually slipped into negative territory, resulting in a modest decline by the close.
